Real local literal fixture preserves prototype-like names, single/double spaces, composed/decomposed accents, CRLF, Unicode and HTML-like strings as exact DOM text and downloaded JSON. Source ordinals remain visible; no injected element/request/execution. At390 CSS pixels all required visible fields, controls, witness prompts and path lists are readable without document horizontal overflow or hidden/truncated text. Capture desktop and narrow original images, open details and inspect key sections.

Single concept has no invented links or dependents. A valid fixture padded only with JSON whitespace to exactly262144 captured bytes remains admitted;262145 refuses. Refusals keep the prior exact admitted report/provenance, reenable its selection/download, and explicitly say it is the previous file.

Malformed literal UTF-8 embedded in otherwise valid JSON, original BOM behavior, invalid JSON, cyclic dependencies and uncovered concepts refuse; no alternate validator or lossy decoding. A same-named different-content file must obtain its own byte/hash identity, not reuse the prior filename cache.
A canceled file choice preserves the current course/report and current selection. Clear removes them and disables download. An invalid file from empty state leaves no admitted report.

Controlled File.arrayBuffer deferred promises allow observable pending state. A later valid input retires the older read; releasing the old success must not replace current metadata/report/download. A late failure also cannot erase a newer success. Clear while read pending prevents resurrection. Keep all original fixture bytes exact.

Controlled crypto.subtle.digest completion creates a distinct post-read pending interval. Selection/download remain disabled and aria-busy/state explicit. A newer file or Clear retires the pending request. Releasing stale hash success or failure cannot revive old state.

A controlled createObjectURL/preparation refusal leaves current admitted course and selection available, emits an error status and allows a subsequent ordinary actual download with the same exact expected envelope. Do not claim rollback of an already delivered file.

Native resources, all admitted source/helper/runtime files and original fixtures are pinned before/after. Only own direct-file navigation and explicit blob downloads are allowed; no upload/provider/network or automatic local/session storage. Actual browser identity must be owned by the launch chain; retained native process-handle READY precedes closing. Confirm Browser.close and actual browser exit0 separately from launcher exit before profile deletion. Preserve any failure and unknown cleanup; no forced unrelated process action.

asynchronousTestBoundary: Test-only browser hooks may control File.arrayBuffer, crypto.subtle.digest or URL.createObjectURL timing/failure on exact fixture instances. Restore each hook and retain its original error/result. These controls cannot replace the parser, renderer, application state, downloaded report or acceptance oracle.
